Mapagmahal St., Diliman, Quezon City OFFICE OF THE NO 200C 02 March 2006 VICE MAYOR ERNESTO MERCADO Makati City Dear Sir: This refers to your request for "authority" from this Department for your LOCCII GOvemment Unit to use a portion of your Calamity Fund to finance the construction c": a school classroom or barangay hall at Barangay Guinsaugon, St. Bemard, Southee Leyte, in view of the tragedy that occurred in the latter. Please be informed that in lieu of an "authority", may we render an opinion thereon. Let it be noted that Section 5 (b) (b.2) of the Implementing Rules and Regulations cf Republic Act No. 8185 (An Act Amending Section 324 [d] Of Republic Act No. 7160, otherwise known as the Local Govemment Code, provides that: 'JA portion of the Calamity Fund may also be authorized to be used by the LGU concerned to provide financial assistance to other LGUs whose area or portion thereof had been declared under the state of calamity by its sanggunian." Ergo, your city may utilize a portion of your Calamity Fund allocation as financial assistance to other LGUs provided that a state of calamity had been declared in tho latter's area or portion thereof by its concemed sanggunian. We hope to have addressed your concern accordingly. Very truly yours, By Authority of the Secretary: PASCU . VERON Head Executive Assista Legal:87/La cc: Dlr. Rodolfo S.
